scope: Sixteen dense parser-CST child traversals in compiler analysis/callfacts. Actual native compiler parse/check consumer; no general ipairs lowering or new runtime/emitter semantics.
disposition: Positive controlled native component result, correctness complete; source integration requires parent acceptance. One cold project pair is diagnostic only. Candidate remains slower than production-main LuaJIT on this component.

contract.scope: Source-bound proof for sixteen parser-CST child traversal changes; not a general ipairs optimization. Correctness and duration results are recorded separately.

producer.contract: cst.add appends at#n+1 and ignores nil children. Parser-CST numeric children therefore form a dense ordered array.

contract.rootConsumer: check/init.nupp3627 invokes analysis.run on the parsed/checker-decorated root. analysis.run invokes callfacts.reset/run and its own summary traversals; queries.body receives the same body/subtree.
contract.preserved: The sixteen loops retain their recursive calls and all branch/return/skip behavior. Tokens are handled by the original guards. Numeric loop limits are cached once, which is equivalent because the traversals do not edit numeric child arrays.

analysis.collectFunctions.walk: Creates summary records, updates local functions/byDefinition/literalDefinitions maps, writes target.effectInfo only.
analysis.inferFunction.collectBindings: Updates localDefinitions/union-find maps; reads definition metadata.
analysis.inferFunction.walk: Updates effect summaries/target context and reads named node metadata; no structural child updates.
analysis.inferFunction.cleanupEffects: Reads cleanup metadata and records summary effects; no structural updates.

callfacts.walkBody.visitThreeSites: Updates facts/pending/access maps and named proof metadata; annotate is a boolean, not an external callback.
callfacts.markUnstable.escapes: Adds entries to local changed map.
callfacts.reset.visit: Clears only named call/proof metadata and definition.callFactsUnstable.

contract.mutationAudit: Neither analysis.nupp nor callfacts.nupp calls cst.add/table.insert/table.remove or writes numeric node indices. Recursive traversal remains within these local functions; checker reporting occurs after summary traversal. Dense child identity/order validation added to dedicated densecstwalktest suite, including repeated analysis and query walks.
contract.scopeLimit: These compiler APIs accept parser CSTs and regions of them. This proposal does not claim equivalence for arbitrary holey or concurrently edited user tables.

actualPinnedColdFixpoint.scope: Sixteen dense parser-CST child traversals: broad shared and actual pinned cold three-stage fixpoint; no timing claim

pinnedStageProof.scope: Actual verified-pinned-seed cold three-stage fixpoint; stage2==stage3 enforced by fixpoint.run before root.image is written. Independent of ordinary native self-emission.

nativeSelfImage.scope: Unmeasured matched native compiler self-emission stability; no timing claim

nativeBuild.baselineBinding: Ordinary current-source baseline image differed from9351. Fresh matched baseline object/binary built; no object attached to a different image.

mechanism.initialExpectedMechanismGap: Initial gate expected16 GetIdxI sites. Artifacts show ordinary numeric-for keeps its source variable boxed: GetIdx+16, CallDyn-32, PadResults-32 and additional generic numeric loop guards. No source change or hidden alias was added. The exact candidate now targets iterator construction/call/frame traffic only; native counters and duration remain required.
mechanism.limits: Ordinary numeric-for remains boxed and adds GetIdx rather than GetIdxI. Benefit is measured iterator/frame/allocation traffic reduction. Missing top16 builtins are not zero; no unsupported opstats claim.

formal.workload: Each fresh process parses/checks the identical frozen32-function source16times with fresh memory-only environment per iteration. Includes process/image or LuaJIT/cache load, module initialization, environment creation, parse/check/GC and checksum. No repeated project I/O inside the driver. Native uses identical interpreted driver over primary AOT compiler bodies.
formal.quietCoordination: ROOT confirmed all other lanes idle/read-only after hardened residual proof; heavy work held through full balanced12 verdict

bootstrap.statistic: geometric mean of paired wall ratios

formal.outlierPolicy: Keep every warmup/sample and raw output; no filtering/retries. Verify both native and main immutable inputs before and after every lane, outside child timing.

mainProduct.comparisonMeaning: Product main LuaJIT versus native compiler branch. Compiler source/runtime representations differ intentionally; not an isolated backend or source-candidate speedup. Same source text, loop semantics, repeat count, cache policy, and valid checksum. Measure whole fresh-process wall and CPU/rusage if later authorized, with balanced paired order. No duration verdict here.
mainProduct.cachePolicy: Fresh process each sample; normal within-process module/JIT cache retained; fresh checker env with persistent caches disabled each repeat. No main launcher/build invoked.

cold191Diagnostic.scope: One diagnostic native191-file cold check pair, not a confidence interval or full duration verdict. Same frozen source/file list, exact matched native image/object pairs, fresh per-lane caches.
cold191Diagnostic.limit: One fresh process pair; no confidence interval or full CLI duration verdict.

preservation: All original baselines, first static expectation failure, raw samples/outlier, sources/images/objects/core, and rejected prior prototypes retained. No main/remote/pin/seed changes.
